arxiv-2006-16198.creator: M. Mouçouf
arxiv-2006-16198.description: Abstract . We derive a closed-form expression for the kth power of semicirculant matrices by using the determinant of certain matrices. As an application, a closed-form expression for the kth power of r r -circulant matrices is also povided. 2010 Mathematics Subject Classification 15B05, 11B83 Department of Mathematics, Faculty of Science, Chouaib Doukkali University, Morocco Email: moucouf@hotmail.com 1.

arxiv-2105-05981.title: Assessing Semantic Frames to Support Program Comprehension Activities Thanks: This work was supported under the Natural Sciences and Engineering Research Council of Canada (RGPIN-2016-03758).
arxiv-2105-05981.creator: Arthur Marques, Giovanni Viviani, Gail C. Murphy
arxiv-2105-05981.description: Abstract Software developers often rely on natural language text that appears in software engineering artifacts to access critical information as they build and work on software systems. For example, developers access requirements documents to understand what to build, comments in source code to understand design decisions, answers to questions on Q&A sites to understand APIs, and so on.

arxiv-2303-16116.title: Period-doubling bifurcations and islets of stability in two-degree-of-freedom Hamiltonian systems
arxiv-2303-16116.creator: Alexandre R. Nieto, Jesús M. Seoane, Miguel A.F. Sanjuán
arxiv-2303-16116.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Alexandre R. Nieto, Jesús M. Seoane, Miguel A.F. Sanjuán. In this paper, we show that the destruction of the main KAM islands in two-degree-of-freedom Hamiltonian systems occurs through a cascade of period-doubling bifurcations. We calculate the corresponding Feigenbaum constant and the accumulation point of the period-doubling sequence. By means of a systematic grid search on exit basin diagrams, we find the existence of numerous very small KAM islands (“islets”) for values below and above the aforementioned accumulation point.

arxiv-2306-01984.title: DYffusion: A Dynamics-informed Diffusion Model for Spatiotemporal Forecasting
arxiv-2306-01984.creator: Salva Rühling Cachay Bo Zhao Hailey Joren Rose Yu
arxiv-2306-01984.description: Abstract While diffusion models can successfully generate data and make predictions, they are predominantly designed for static images. We propose an approach for efficiently training diffusion models for probabilistic spatiotemporal forecasting, where generating stable and accurate rollout forecasts remains challenging, Our method, DYffusion, leverages the temporal dynamics in the data, directly coupling it with the diffusion steps in the model.

arxiv-2309-03185.title: Bayes’ Rays: Uncertainty Quantification for Neural Radiance Fields
arxiv-2309-03185.creator: Lily Goli Cody Reading Silvia Sellán Alec Jacobson Andrea Tagliasacchi, [.5em] University of Toronto Simon Fraser University Google DeepMind Adobe Research
arxiv-2309-03185.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Lily Goli Cody Reading Silvia Sellán Alec Jacobson Andrea Tagliasacchi, [.5em] University of Toronto Simon Fraser University Google DeepMind Adobe Research. Neural Radiance Fields (NeRFs) have shown promise in applications like view synthesis and depth estimation, but learning from multiview images faces inherent uncertainties. Current methods to quantify them are either heuristic or computationally demanding.

arxiv-2401-03890.title: A Survey on 3D Gaussian Splatting
arxiv-2401-03890.creator: Guikun Chen, Wenguan Wang
arxiv-2401-03890.description: Abstract 3D Gaussian splatting (GS) has emerged as a transformative technique in explicit radiance field and computer graphics. This innovative approach, characterized by the use of millions of learnable 3D Gaussians, represents a significant departure from mainstream neural radiance field approaches, which predominantly use implicit, coordinate-based models to map spatial coordinates to pixel values.

arxiv-2406-08643.title: The Steinitz Realization Problem
arxiv-2406-08643.creator: Sameera Vemulapalli
arxiv-2406-08643.description: Abstract . Let K K be a number field and let n ∈ ℤ > 1 n\in\mathbb{Z}_{>1} . The Steinitz realization problem asks: does every element of Cl ⁡ ( K ) \Cl(K) occur as the Steinitz class of a degree n n extension of K K ?

arxiv-2409-01993.title: Comment on “Excluding Primordial Black Holes as Dark Matter Based on Solar System Ephemeris”
arxiv-2409-01993.creator: James M. Cline
arxiv-2409-01993.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by James M. Cline. It was recently claimed ( https://arxiv.org/pdf/2408.10799 ) that solar system ephemeris data can exclude primordial black hole (PBH) dark matter in the mass range 10 18 − 10 22 10^{18}-10^{22} g. We show that this conclusion is based on an implausible, implicit assumption; namely the uncertainty on the solar system mass within 50 au is as small as the uncertainty on the mass of the sun.

arxiv-2411-02902.title: Membership Inference Attacks against Large Vision-Language Models
arxiv-2411-02902.creator: Zhan Li, Yongtao Wu, Yihang Chen
arxiv-2411-02902.description: Abstract Large vision-language models (VLLMs) exhibit promising capabilities for processing multi-modal tasks across various application scenarios. However, their emergence also raises significant data security concerns, given the potential inclusion of sensitive information, such as private photos and medical records, in their training datasets.

arxiv-2411-06087.title: Cross-Domain Transfer Learning using Attention Latent Features for Multi-Agent Trajectory Prediction
arxiv-2411-06087.creator: Jia Quan Loh, Xuewen Luo, Fan Ding, Hwa Hui Tew, Junn Yong Loo, Ze Yang Ding, Susilawati Susilawati, Chee Pin Tan
arxiv-2411-06087.description: Abstract With the advancements of sensor hardware, traffic infrastructure and deep learning architectures, trajectory prediction of vehicles has established a solid foundation in intelligent transportation systems. However, existing solutions are often tailored to specific traffic networks at particular time periods. Consequently, deep learning models trained on one network may struggle to generalize effectively to unseen networks.

arxiv-2412-16665.title: Determination of the strong coupling and its running from measurements of inclusive jet production
arxiv-2412-16665.description: Abstract The value of the strong coupling \alpS \alpS is determined in a comprehensive analysis at next-to-next-to-leading order accuracy in quantum chromodynamics. The analysis uses double-differential cross section measurements from the CMS Collaboration at the CERN LHC of inclusive jet production in proton-proton collisions at centre-of-mass energies of 2.

arxiv-2508-17914.title: Evaluating the Representation of Vowels in Wav2Vec Feature Extractor: A Layer-Wise Analysis Using MFCCs
arxiv-2508-17914.creator: Domenico De Cristofaro, Vincenzo Norman Vitale, Alessandro Vietti
arxiv-2508-17914.description: Abstract Automatic Speech Recognition has advanced with self-supervised learning, enabling feature extraction directly from raw audio. In Wav2Vec, a CNN first transforms audio into feature vectors before the transformer processes them. This study examines CNN-extracted information for monophthong vowels using the TIMIT corpus.

arxiv-2602-17524.title: Inspiral tests of general relativity and waveform geometry
arxiv-2602-17524.creator: Brian C. Seymour, Jacob Golomb, Yanbei Chen
arxiv-2602-17524.description: Abstract The phase evolution of gravitational waves encodes critical information about the orbital dynamics of binary systems. In this work, we test the robustness of parameterized tests against unmodeled deviations from general relativity. We demonstrate that these parameterized tests are flexible and sensitive in detecting generic deviations in the waveform using the Cutler-Vallisneri bias formalism.

Remnant cholesterol (remnant-C) is considered one of the principal residual risk factors for cardiovascular disease and metabolic disorders; however, there are limited studies on the impact of remnant-C on sarcopenia.

pmc-11391669.title: Intraosseous myofibroma mimicking an odontogenic lesion: case report, literature review, and differential diagnosis
pmc-11391669.creator: José Wittor de Macêdo Santos, Benito K Benitez, Daniel Baumhoer, Daphne Schönegg, Thomas Schrepfer, Andreas A Mueller, Florian M Thieringer
pmc-11391669.description: BackgroundIntraosseous myofibroma of the jaw is a rare neoplasm of mesenchymal origin with limited comprehensive understanding. It typically affects patients in the first two decades of life with a male predilection.Case presentationThis study presents a rare case of myofibroma mimicking an odontogenic lesion in a 2-year-old boy.

pmc-11430210.title: Evaluating ECM stiffness and liver cancer radiation response via shear-wave elasticity in 3D culture models
pmc-11430210.creator: Shao-Lun Lu, Yu Pei, Wei-Wen Liu, Kun Han, Jason Chia-Hsien Cheng, Pai-Chi Li
pmc-11430210.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundThe stiffness of the tumor microenvironment (TME) directly influences cellular behaviors. Radiotherapy (RT) is a common treatment for solid tumors, but the TME can impact its efficacy. In the case of liver cancer, clinical observations have shown that tumors within a cirrhotic, stiffer background respond less to RT, suggesting that the extracellular matrix (ECM) stiffness plays a critical role in the development of radioresistance.MethodsThis study explored the effects of ECM stiffness and the inhibition of lysyl oxidase (LOX) isoenzymes on the radiation

pmc-11561444.title: Efficacy of a Multimodal Digital Behavior Change Intervention on Lifestyle Behavior, Cardiometabolic Biomarkers, and Medical Expenditure: Protocol for a Randomized Controlled Trial
pmc-11561444.creator: Sakeina Howard-Wilson, Jack Ching, Sherri Gentile, Martin Ho, Alex Garcia, Didem Ayturk, Peter Lazar, Nova Hammerquist, David McManus, Bruce Barton, Steven Bird, John Moore, Apurv Soni
pmc-11561444.description: BackgroundThe US Preventive Services Task Force recommends providers offer individualized healthy behavior interventions for all adults, independent of their risk of cardiovascular disease. While strong evidence exists to support disease-specific programs designed to improve multiple lifestyle behaviors, approaches to adapting these interventions for a broader population are not well established.

pmc-11632355.title: Description of Mesopolobusaskewi sp. nov. (Hymenoptera, Pteromalidae), with notes on the fauna of Asaphesinae and Pteromalidae (Hymenoptera, Chalcidoidea) collected from foliage of Piceaabies (L.) H. Karst. in Bulgaria
pmc-11632355.creator: Ivaylo Todorov, Mircea-Dan Mitroiu, Aneliya Bobeva, Peter Boyadzhiev
pmc-11632355.description: BackgroundMesopolobus Westwood, 1833 consists of about 135 valid species worldwide. After the fundamental monograph of Graham (1969), 12 species have been described from continental Europe and three species have been described from the Canary Islands and Malta. Amongst them, one species, Mesopolobusblascoi Askew, 1994, has been synonymised under Mesopolobusmaculipennis (Mercet, 1923).

pmc-11671695.title: Engaging under‐represented oldest old in research: An approach for inclusive recruitment
pmc-11671695.creator: Naomi Paine, Melanie Lowe, Charlotte Young, Gavin Turrell
pmc-11671695.description: IntroductionThose aged 80 years and over are the fastest‐growing sector of the Australian population but are often excluded from research. Oldest old people living alone, in disadvantaged neighbourhoods, and with ill health or dementia, face additional barriers that may hinder their participation in research.MethodsThis paper contributes timely critical commentary on methodological and ethical approaches to engaging under‐represented people in research.

pmc-12464339.title: Pediatric Gastric Adenocarcinoma in the Setting of Celiac Disease: A Rare and Insightful Case Report
pmc-12464339.creator: Mahsa Rouhafshari, Mohammad Hadi Imanieh, Mahdi Khazaei, Fateme Ziyaee, Hamide Barzegar
pmc-12464339.description: Gastric adenocarcinoma is exceptionally rare in children, often presenting with nonspecific gastrointestinal (GI) symptoms. This case highlights the importance of considering malignancy in pediatric patients with celiac disease and poor dietary adherence, as complications like gastric adenocarcinoma can arise. Early recognition and multidisciplinary management are crucial for improving outcomes in such rare and aggressive cases.

pmc-12932335.title: Spatial representation of serial order in working memory: a cross-cultural comparison between Japanese and Italian adults
pmc-12932335.creator: Roberta Bettoni, Daichi Yamashiro, Megumi Kobayashi, Masami K Yamaguchi, Luca Rinaldi, Viola Macchi Cassia
pmc-12932335.description: The spontaneous spatialization of serial order in working memory (WM), often reflected by the SPoARC effect, is thought to be influenced by reading/writing habits. However, cross-cultural research comparing the direction of spatial organization in WM remains limited. Here we investigated the spontaneity of this spatialization (its independence from visual-spatial prompts) and its generalizability across different cultural reading systems (Italian vs.

pmc-13188788.title: Juggling conflicting demands: registered nurses’ experiences of goal conflicts in acute illness consultations in primary care – a thematic analysis
pmc-13188788.creator: Malin Östman, Karin Bergman, Sofia Östensson, Inger K Holmström
pmc-13188788.description: BackgroundPrimary care includes preventive and acute care, and management of long-term conditions. In Sweden, approximately 40 million annual visits are made to primary care, of which more than 12 million are registered nurse consultations. Registered nurses are often responsible for initial assessments, including triage and prioritization.

pmc-13223823.title: Diagnosis of intermittent hydronephrosis on multiphase CT intravenous pyelogram and [99mTc]Tc-MAG3 study–Homsy sign
pmc-13223823.creator: Tahleesa Cuda, Chetan Thapa, David A. Pattison, William Fong
pmc-13223823.description: A 40-year-old female was investigated for intermittent right flank pain and management of large uterine fibroids. A multiphase CT intravenous pyelogram showed the development of mild right hydronephrosis and hydroureter between the non-contrast and delayed pyelogram phases of imaging, secondary to large uterine fibroids compressing the pelvic course of the right ureter.

pmc-13494737.title: Attitudes Toward Injectable GLP‐1 Drugs for Obesity Treatment: A Qualitative Interview Study With Healthcare Professionals
pmc-13494737.creator: Raluca C. Capaian, Phillippa Lally, Saskia C. Sanderson
pmc-13494737.description: BackgroundInjectable GLP‐1 drugs such as semaglutide (Wegovy) and tirzepatide (Mounjaro, a dual GLP‐1 and GIP receptor agonist) can help individuals living with obesity to lose weight. UK guidelines currently recommend semaglutide and other injectable GLP‐1 drugs are prescribed in specialist (Tier 3) multidisciplinary weight management services, and other settings.

pmc-13503158.title: Preoperative localization in primary hyperparathyroidism: a stepwise approach integrating PTH-FNA washout and second-line 18F-choline PET/CT
pmc-13503158.creator: Antonino Russo, Marco Erini, Davide Donner, Fabio Magnani, Silvia Fasanella, Pierluigi Amadori, Carlo Cosimo Quattrocchi, Vito Racanelli
pmc-13503158.description: ObjectiveAccurate preoperative localization of parathyroid adenomas is essential for the success of minimally invasive parathyroidectomy. This study evaluated the detection rate of parathyroid hormone assay on fine-needle aspiration washout and in conventional and advanced imaging modalities modeling a hypothetical stepwise diagnostic approach for primary hyperparathyroidism.

uslaw-usc-t11-s341.title: 11 U.S.C. § 341 — Meetings of creditors and equity security holders
uslaw-usc-t11-s341.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t11-s341.description: United States Code, Title 11 (Bankruptcy); Chapter 3 (Case Administration); Subchapter III (Administration). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) Within a reasonable time after the order for relief in a case under this title, the United States trustee shall convene and preside at a meeting of creditors. (b) The United States trustee may convene a meeting of any equity security holders. (c).
